headline: Lenskart Solutions Limited: Arrangements for strategic, technical, manufacturing, or marketing tie up
sum: Arrangements for strategic, technical, manufacturing, or marketing tie up — LENSKART: Lenskart Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about the incorporation of a Joint Venture Company in India with Mingfeng Glassesworld Limited,…
detail: Arrangements for strategic, technical, manufacturing, or marketing tie up — LENSKART: Lenskart Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about the incorporation of a Joint Venture Company in India with Mingfeng Glassesworld Limited, pursuant to a strategic partnership between the parties.
